name: 35° po Tselsiyu ili povsednevnaya zhizn v ne povsednevnoy situatsii
original_name: 35° по Цельсию или повседневная жизнь в не повседневной ситуации
source:
The protagonist has no personal life. He has no hope for anything better. Yet he always believes in a better outcome. He never stops believing. But suddenly, Fate gives him... A chance? A gift? A curse? Happiness, or is it just a fateful coincidence? But one thing is for sure - this event will completely change his life...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2969333003]Steam[/url]]
